key.name: show-latency-label
key.description: Whether to show the "Latency:" text before the ping value

key.name: latency-ip-wan
key.description: The IP WAN address for the ping

key.name: latency-resolve-domain
key.description: The domain to resolve to detect DNS failures

key.name: latency-position
key.description: Position of the indicator in the panel: 'left' or 'right'

key.name: latency-threshold-warning
key.description: Latency above this value (ms) will be shown in yellow

key.name: latency-threshold-critical
key.description: Latency above this value (ms) will be shown in red

key.name: latency-color-ok
key.description: Hex color shown when latency is below the warning threshold

key.name: latency-color-warning
key.description: Hex color shown when latency is between warning and critical thresholds

key.name: latency-color-critical
key.description: Hex color shown when latency is above the critical threshold

key.name: latency-refresh-interval
key.description: How often to run the ping check (in seconds)
